text.tspan: Same semantic IR · Post-LayerNorm · independent layer parameters
Solid: model forward · dashed: explanation · cross-attention SDPA is folded
Tensor glyphs: Q blue · K green · V pink. Same type ≠ shared parameters. Macro flow ↑; attention detail ↓; FFN detail →.
Masks act before Softmax; causal mask is supplied by caller. ReLU · fixed sinusoidal PE · no generation loop shown.
Dropout / NaN guard are folded in the view and retained in semantic_ir.json. Matrix grids are symbolic.
